_comment: mon.c see_monster_closeup() 5999-6018 from apply.c do_blinding_ray(): a Tourist earns experience(mtmp, 0) points and a newexplevel() check the first time she photographs each species with her expensive camera, except her unchanged starting pet. A Tourist with showexp photographs her little dog (no points), creates a peaceful dwarf lord and photographs it (20 points, experience level 2), then photographs it again (no points). Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
